s: to go in, to go inside
to mix into, to blend into
A prefix, conveying a movement into something.
to get swept up in something
to come into play, to have a part to play
to mix into, to add as a mush
to pull in, to drag in (into an enclosed location)

to embroil, to involve, to sweep up (in a situation)
to be pulled into a war
to move in (e.g. troops into a city, smoke into a room)
to interpret into (something) a meaning that doesn't exist

hineinoptieren.et: hinein- + optieren. Partial calque of English opt in.

s: to listen to one's inner voice
to put into (money, effort, time etc.)
to put oneself in someone's shoes, to empathize with someone
to ease in, to move in
to let in (to let someone or something come in) (in direction away from the speaker)
to sort or place into something
to give/take/put something into something (in direction away from the speaker)
to call into, to shout into
to be permitted or be able to move into something or inside (in direction away from the speaker)
